## beauty_editorial_layout

> Magazine-style beauty editorial spread — close-up beauty shot with small product callouts.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/beauty/_vars_examples/beauty_editorial_layout.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A beauty-magazine editorial spread for the Murmur Quarterly No.07 issue, leading with a single composed beauty shot — a soft close-up of skin, lips, eyes, or a held bottle — and supported by two small flat-lay product callouts. Look title: "Skin, after the rain". The page reads as a feature-spread plate, not a product ad. No models with identifying faces (frame chosen so that one feature dominates rather than a recognizable portrait); no celebrity likeness.
[2. Action] The eye is drawn to the central beauty close-up first, then flicks to the small product callouts in the lower band, then settles on the look title set near the upper third. The composition feels like a magazine page being read in natural flow, not a billboard.
[3. Scene] Studio-clean editorial environment. The mood is "calm and slightly dewy" in the season "early autumn". Backdrop is a soft tonal sweep in rain-grey neutrals with warm sand, lit from a single soft window source. No retail context, no bathroom, no real-store fixtures.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 magazine plate. Top ~58% holds the hero close-up bleeding to the edges. A thin horizontal rule separates the hero from a lower band that holds two small flat-lay callouts (a bottle and a swatch on paper) and the look title set as a serif display line above them. Edition label sits as a small masthead-style line in the upper-left margin. Generous 5% safe margins.
[5. Style] Beauty editorial finish keyed to the rain-grey neutrals with warm sand palette and the calm and slightly dewy mood. Skin tones rendered honestly — pores and fine texture preserved, no plastic smoothing. Light is window-soft, contrast is gentle, color grading is tonal rather than saturated. Type system: a refined transitional serif for the look title, a quiet sans for the masthead. No HDR, no AI-glossy plastic, no makeup mask look.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- edition_label: "Murmur Quarterly No.07"
- look_title: "Skin, after the rain"

NO: real-celebrity likeness, identifying portrait of a famous person, real famous magazine mastheads, real famous beauty brand logos, HDR oversaturation, plastic skin smoothing, heavy makeup mask, rainbow palette, lens flare halos, watermarks, stock-photo staging, retail-shelf clutter
```

## beauty_skincare_packaging

> Single skincare unit on minimal staging — bottle / jar / dropper as design hero.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/beauty/_vars_examples/beauty_skincare_packaging.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A single skincare unit for the fictional house "Solene" in its Quiet Hours Serum line — a 30 ml frosted apothecary glass bottle, jar or dropper rendered as the sole hero of the frame. The wordmark sits cleanly on the package face; the product line name is set as a small typeset label. Key ingredient "5% niacinamide and oat ferment" appears as a discreet caption on the package or beneath it. No model, no hands, no skin, no bathroom — just the object, framed as a still life.
[2. Action] The viewer's eye lands on the brand mark, drops to the line name, then registers the surface texture and the slim accent color. The composition is contemplative, not promotional — closer to a design-press still life than a sales ad.
[3. Scene] Editorial studio still life. A soft graduated paper-stone backdrop sweeps from a slightly darker top to a softly lit floor. A single soft key light from upper-left casts a calm, contained shadow that grounds the unit. No water droplets, no splashes, no botanicals strewn around — only quiet light.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1. The product unit occupies the central ~55% area on a low pedestal or directly on the floor sweep. Generous negative space framing the unit. Brand wordmark is naturally aligned to the package face, never floated as a banner. Bottom ~10% is a quiet safe band where the volume can sit as typeset caption. Slim accent stripe in soft moss green.
[5. Style] Clean-beauty editorial finish — Aesop, Byredo, Glossier-press aesthetic without copying any of them. Palette anchored on soft moss green with stone, bone, or warm linen neutrals. Materials read as matte glass, sandblasted ceramic, or soft-touch paperboard — never glossy plastic, never specular chrome. Type system: a quiet humanist sans or refined transitional serif. Lighting is controlled and considered.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- brand_name: "Solene"
- product_line: "Quiet Hours Serum"
- volume: "30 ml"
- key_ingredient: "with 5% niacinamide and oat ferment"

NO: human models or hands, skin close-ups, bathroom or vanity context, water splashes, botanical clutter, real famous beauty brand logos, glossy plastic specular highlights, rainbow gradients, lens flare, neon glow, watermarks, 3D chrome reflections
```
